text:
maria: Heads up — I'm planning to push structured-log schema v2 to staging tonight (22:00 UTC). Main changes: canonical request_id, remove raw user.identity (PII) in favor of hashed_id, add pii_tags array, and support for an X-Log-Sample header so services can opt into sampling. Need quick eyes on alert/dashboard impacts and retention implications.

ashok: quick q — are we expecting to shove GPU telemetry into logs? we currently rely on prometheus exporters for node.gpu.*, want to avoid log volume surge.

devon: +1 on avoiding noisy gpu metrics in logs. For inference tracing we do want cache hit/miss and model_variant in logs so we can correlate tail latency to model routing decisions.

olivia: noted. i'll prep dashboard changes to accept both legacy and v2 fields (vars + migration mapping) so dashboards don't break during rollout.

juan: security note — removing user.identity is good. we need a spec for hashed_id (salted sha256) and an indication of whether a field is reversible. Also confirm KMS tagging for any encrypted blobs. retention numbers: proposal: raw logs 30d, parsed/indices 90d, aggregates 365d. who owns retention config?

sre-oncall-bot: @channel deploy scheduled to staging at 22:00 UTC, runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/log-schema-migration, CI: https://ci.redwood.local/12345

logbot: schema lint OK, validator reports 0 warnings. Sampling header support added to validator (X-Log-Sample: "pct=1,reason=cost-control").

maria: put a minimal v2 snippet here — comments inline.

```json
{
  "schema_version": "2",
  "request_id": "string",
  "timestamp": "iso8601",
  "service": "string",
  "level": "string",
  "message": "string",
  "model_variant": "string",     // inference routing
  "cache": { "kv_hit": "boolean" },
  "pii_tags": ["email", "phone"],
  "hashed_id": "string",         // salted sha256, not reversible
  "gpu_instance_type": "string", // optional, only present when applicable
  "sampling": { "source": "header|service", "pct": "number" }
}
```

ashok: cost note — sampling is key. default 1% for debug logs, 100% for GPU OOMs/error streams and inference tail traces. we should make rules by namespace + severity.

devon: can we add gpu_instance_type when a GPU is attached? helps us attribute cost per model/instance. also would like an enum for model_variant so queries are fast.

olivia: i'll wire gpu_instance_type into the cost dashboards and add a breakdown panel. also proposing to relax the GPU node CPU alert from 85% -> 90% until we have baseline for mixed cpu/gpu workloads to reduce false positives.

maria: rollout plan: merge PR after EOD review, deploy to staging at 22:00 UTC, 48h soak with retention/ingest monitoring; if stable, gradual prod rollout with sampling rules (namespace-based) over 7 days. fallback: legacy fields still indexed for 14 days. objections?

ashok: no objections. make sure sampling config is centrally managed (config-service) so we can tweak without redeploys.

juan: please add KMS tagging to the PR and update the security checklist. i'll review the hashed_id scheme tomorrow morning.

devon: will add model_variant enum to the PR.

olivia: i'll open the dashboard PR and adjust alert thresholds.

maria: thanks all — if no objections by EOD i'll trigger the staging deploy. ping me if you spot any regression in the staging metrics (ingest rate, cost, SLO error budget).
